arms.rules: today's DCLab: the proposal accepted, nothing stated

gate.honest_estimate: validation beats the holdout by at most 3.5 times both estimates' noise together (the holdout's from its bootstrap interval, validation's from the folds' spread over the root of their count; without an interval: within 5% of the validation score; without a validation score: failed)
gate.beats_baseline: the holdout better than the best simple baseline; without a holdout or a baseline: failed
gate.known_before: no honest column known before the moment kept out (one check), and each decoy kept in (a check each)
gate.solvable: a variant counts only when its reference statements pass every check; one that does not, or whose attempt broke, is dropped and listed
gate.sealed: a sealed partition is read once per promotion of the whole loop: its marker is written before the first solve
gate.pass: a baseline is a measurement, not a promotion: it passes when every scored variant was solvable

verdict: ok: baseline recorded, today's DCLab passes 3 of 20 learning variants
rule: every variant drawn from its seed, written apart from its key, solved from its public folder, graded by code
